decisions.reason: A multi-model operator line with its own website page is a visible, substantial investment central to the garage door system offering, so dropping it after one year would write off that commitment.

The solid wood door is a niche variant that is only mentioned on the website, so little public commitment protects it, but one year is too early to blame weak results on anything but start-up effects.
The remote-control operator complements the garage door range, and any early weakness can still be put down to temporary launch effects.
This glazed industrial door is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is limited, yet it fits the core industrial door portfolio and has had little time to prove itself.
The insulated glazed door supports the firm's announced thermal-solution direction, which makes keeping it easier to justify despite its modest website presence.
With its own website page, this door is a visible commitment within the core industrial range, so management would persist with it.
